name: Checkpoint mid air super: a super from a respawn's held onGround
techNote: The state a respawn leaves at a checkpoint 64 u above its floor (Movement.respawn: 12 u under the checkpoint, onGround set, coyoteFrames kept from before, Velocity 0): the lab starts one tick after a quick restart from the ground (onGround held, coyoteFrames 5, falling). Dash right on the fourth tick with jump on its first frame: onGround is still held (coyoteFrames 1), so the jump is the super (CheckForSuperJump: 805 up, 876 momentum right) from 58 u above the floor. It peaks at y 347.5 (hitbox top 374) and is in the finish box (x 620-820, y 330-380) on tick 30; the same super from the floor peaks at 288.8 (top 315.6) and misses it. The `restart` demo is the whole thing with the quick restart: standing on the floor, the respawn point 64 u up, a quick restart on input 5, and the same dash 4 ticks later (the super on tick 10). The main demo starts after the restart because a graft never quick-restarts (the tech-graft miner drops any window with a reset in it).

ghosts.label: The same super from the floor
